page.layout: One printed page: a single tree diagram (outline with braces) running down the page. No running text, no running head, no page number.

main_text.l: Aves. Quæ singulariter quoq; habet in
Trunco, præter binos pedes etiam alas duas, volatus organa[?].
Quadrupeda. Hæc peculiariter obtinet quoque trunco, tin[?]

page.notes: Diagram read box by box; levels follow the braces. Doubtful readings: "trunco, tin[?]" (last word cut off at the fold of the brace, possibly "tum"); "organa[?]" (the scan reads "orgsna"). The faint word behind "Trunco" and the mirrored show-through on the right edge are not transcribed. The Q at the root is a printed flourish or abbreviation mark and is copied as Q. The small dot below "progressiva" is not a letter and is omitted.
